title: Implement catalog_preview_cache component
description:
Implement catalog_preview_cache.py for project catalog-api using the README.md component API. Export the complete approved nested POLICY with exact JSON keys and types, exact SOURCE and RATIONALE, and a working create_cache(clock) returning an independent response cache.

Use the current durable agreement at Beads key catalog-api.response-cache. Retrieve its complete body with:
    bd recall catalog-api.response-cache
This record was retained and read back during trial-3a8 as Operations approval CACHE-18 (2026-09-06), version v2. It applies because catalog_preview_cache is another catalog-api response-cache reader governed by the standing agreement shared across catalog readers. At creation, its policy is TTL 300 seconds, capacity 3, FIFO eviction, namespace catalog-response, and cache_misses true. Read the full durable record for the authoritative nested policy and exact approval fields. This task references the current agreement, not a historical snapshot.

This work depends on trial-3a8, which implemented catalog_refresh_cache.py and permanently revised the standing agreement to v2 while retaining the original v1 approval at catalog-api.response-cache.v1 for audit replay. Preserve earlier components, the historical snapshot, and task history. Reuse cache_engine.ResponseCache as appropriate.

Verify TTL expiry at age >= TTL, FIFO order unaffected by reads, expired entries excluded from capacity, cached None results, namespaced live keys, and independent cache instances. Add relevant component tests and run python3 -m unittest discover -s tests. Do not change historical implementations to v2.
